comparison.objective: Candidate removes a locked terminal; record installs an inner slide member through a ball retainer.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate performs fine blade probing and simultaneous wire-tool withdrawal; record first positions a retainer, then maintains long-axis rail alignment through rolling insertion.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires selective undamaged extraction; record requires ordered retainer engagement and the rail seated at its stop without a shove or misalignment.
comparison.reason: Long guided rolling insertion is a meaningfully different tested ability.
